item.text:
**7B.2 Research Note: Srettha Thavisin (2024)**

**Overall read:** negative-leaning. I found limited evidence that Srettha tolerated some scrutiny, but stronger evidence that he doubled down on disputed claims, denied wrongdoing, and presided over conditions hostile to truthful reporting. I did **not** find a reliable source showing a clear public apology, retraction, or explicit correction of a false claim in 2024.

**Accepted claims**

- **Title:** Thailand  
  **Publisher:** Reuters Institute for the Study of Journalism  
  **Date:** 2024-06-17  
  **URL:** [https://reutersinstitute.politics.ox.ac.uk/digital-news-report/2024/thailand](https://reutersinstitute.politics.ox.ac.uk/digital-news-report/2024/thailand)  
  **Claim:** Thai media could still criticize government policy and cover corruption. This is the clearest positive evidence that truthful reporting was still possible under Srettha’s premiership, even if only partially.  
  **Question IDs:** 7B.2, 7B.1

- **Title:** Thailand  
  **Publisher:** Reuters Institute for the Study of Journalism  
  **Date:** 2024-06-17  
  **URL:** [https://reutersinstitute.politics.ox.ac.uk/digital-news-report/2024/thailand](https://reutersinstitute.politics.ox.ac.uk/digital-news-report/2024/thailand)  
  **Claim:** The same report says media freedom remained constrained, self-censorship was widespread, and journalists were afraid to speak against powerful elites. That cuts against a ruler who welcomes correction or tolerates truth-telling.  
  **Question IDs:** 7B.2, 7B.1

- **Title:** Thai journalists arrested for news coverage of anarchist graffiti on temple  
  **Publisher:** Reuters via Yahoo News  
  **Date:** 2024-02-13  
  **URL:** [https://www.yahoo.com/news/thai-journalists-arrested-news-coverage-054141721.html](https://www.yahoo.com/news/thai-journalists-arrested-news-coverage-054141721.html)  
  **Claim:** Two journalists were arrested over reporting on anti-royal graffiti. In contemporaneous coverage, Srettha said the government was fair on press freedom and that there was no harassment. The arrest and the public denial together are strong negative evidence for 7B.2.  
  **Question IDs:** 7B.2, 7B.1

- **Title:** Thailand to delay launch of massive handout scheme beyond May  
  **Publisher:** Reuters via ThePrint  
  **Date:** 2024-01-17  
  **URL:** [https://theprint.in/tech/thailand-to-delay-launch-of-massive-handout-scheme-beyond-may/1927224/](https://theprint.in/tech/thailand-to-delay-launch-of-massive-handout-scheme-beyond-may/1927224/)  
  **Claim:** The handout scheme slipped beyond its original timeline while the government still said it would move ahead and had no backup plan. That is not a clean falsehood case, but it is evidence of doubling down rather than openly correcting course.  
  **Question IDs:** 7B.2

- **Title:** Thai PM says digital wallet scheme will spur jobs and manufacturing  
  **Publisher:** Reuters via Investing.com  
  **Date:** 2024-07-11  
  **URL:** [https://www.investing.com/news/economy-news/thai-pm-says-digital-wallet-scheme-will-spur-jobs-and-manufacturing-3514879](https://www.investing.com/news/economy-news/thai-pm-says-digital-wallet-scheme-will-spur-jobs-and-manufacturing-3514879)  
  **Claim:** After repeated criticism of the handout plan, Srettha publicly re-sold it as a jobs-and-manufacturing stimulus instead of acknowledging earlier doubts. That supports a reading of rhetorical doubling down rather than candid correction.  
  **Question IDs:** 7B.2

- **Title:** Thai court says PM Srettha violated rules on ethics in cabinet appointment  
  **Publisher:** Reuters via ThePrint  
  **Date:** 2024-08-14  
  **URL:** [https://theprint.in/world/thai-court-says-pm-srettha-violated-rules-on-ethics-in-cabinet-appointment/2222960/](https://theprint.in/world/thai-court-says-pm-srettha-violated-rules-on-ethics-in-cabinet-appointment/2222960/)  
  **Claim:** The Constitutional Court said Srettha violated ethics in his cabinet appointment; Reuters reported that he denied wrongdoing. This is negative evidence for admitting error, though it is not proof of a deliberate lie by itself.  
  **Question IDs:** 7B.2

**Search gap**

- I searched directly for apology, retraction, and blame-shifting language, and I did **not** find a strong 2024 source showing Srettha explicitly admitted a factual error or formally corrected a false public claim.
- The best available evidence is indirect: some remaining media openness on the positive side, but stronger evidence of denial, persistence, and a constrained press environment on the negative side.
